summary: Minesweeper entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Minesweeper
entries.definitive_edition: Classic Windows Minesweeper for preservation; current Microsoft Minesweeper for accessible play

emulation.emulator: Windows 3.1/legacy Windows VM only for historical capture
emulation.notes: Use the current Microsoft app for practical play; use a VM only if preserving the classic UI.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current Windows app, or period-correct Windows UI in VM

primary.why: Microsoft Minesweeper is the culturally dominant Windows route. For practical current play, Microsoft's Casual Games version is accessible; for historical capture, the Windows Entertainment Pack/Windows 3.1 version preserves the original interface.
primary.how_to_play: Use Microsoft Minesweeper for current official play, or a preserved Windows 3.1/Entertainment Pack install for historical UI capture. Record which rule/UI version is being archived.

entries.remaster_caveats: Many minesweeper games exist. This entry is for Microsoft's Windows lineage, not every independent minesweeper variant.
